shortDescription: Manage rpm remotes of a pulp api server instance

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Certificate autority to identify the remote repository.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate to authenticate with the remote repository.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Client key to authenticate with the remote repository. Using this parameter will always report C(changed=true).

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: C(aiohttp.ClientTimeout.connect) for download-connections. The default is null, which will cause the default from the aiohttp library to be used.

options.name: download_concurrency
options.description: Total number of simultaneous connections. If not set then the default value will be used.

options.name: headers
options.description: Headers to pass to the remote server. Specified as a list of dictionaries with single entries so keys can be repeated.

options.name: max_retries
options.description: Maximum number of retry attempts after a download failure. If not set then the default value (3) will be used.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the remote to query or manipulate

options.name: password
options.description: Password of api user. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_PASSWORD) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: policy
options.description: Whether downloads should be performed immediately, or lazy.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the proxy. Using this parameter will always report C(changed=true).

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: The proxy URL. Format C(scheme://host:port) .

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the proxy. Using this parameter will always report C(changed=true).

options.name: pulp_url
options.description: URL of the server to connect to (without 'pulp/api/v3'). If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_PULP_URL) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: rate_limit
options.description: Limits requests per second for each concurrent downloader.

options.name: refresh_api_cache
options.description: Whether the cached API specification should be invalidated. It is recommended to use this once with the M(pulp.squeezer.status) module at the beginning of the playbook.

options.name: remote_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the remote repository. Using this parameter will always report C(changed=true).

options.name: remote_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the remote repository. Using this parameter will always report C(changed=true).

options.name: sock_connect_timeout
options.description: C(aiohttp.ClientTimeout.sock_connect) for download-connections. The default is null, which will cause the default from the aiohttp library to be used.

options.name: sock_read_timeout
options.description: C(aiohttp.ClientTimeout.sock_read) for download-connections. The default is null, which will cause the default from the aiohttp library to be used.

options.name: state
options.description: State the entity should be in

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for tasks.

options.name: tls_validation
options.description: If True, TLS peer validation must be performed on remote synchronization.

options.name: total_timeout
options.description: C(aiohttp.ClientTimeout.total) for download-connections. The default is null, which will cause the default from the aiohttp library to be used.

options.name: url
options.description: URL to the upstream repository

options.name: user_cert
options.description: Client certificate of api user.

options.name: user_key
options.description: Client certificate key of api user.

options.name: username
options.description: Username of api user. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_USERNAME) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether SSL certificates should be verified. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used as a fallback.
